title: UWell Caliburn G4 Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The UWell Caliburn G4 Pod Vape Device boasts a 1300mAh battery, adjustable 5–35W output, animated display, and versatile Storm and Wave Modes for an elevated vaping experience. This sleek device is crafted from durable aluminum alloy and supports a resistance range of 0.4–0.9ohm, optimized for smooth flavor and cloud production. Its magnetic 2ml pod system uses Caliburn G3 Series pods and a convenient top-fill design, ensuring both ease of use and secure handling. With an adjustable airflow switch and intuitive draw-activation, users can fine-tune every puff. Whether in Storm Mode for powerful clouds or Wave Mode for consistent output, the UWell Caliburn G4 Pod Vape Device balances cutting-edge features with compact portability, making it a top-tier choice for everyday vaping.
